The '''command block''' is unchanged from vanilla ''Minecraft''. Matcha Flavoured only uses it as an ingredient in three debug recipes, which craft the markers for the [[Copper Eye|copper eye]] door, grate and lantern used when building the [[Abbey]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/debug/recipe/copper_eye_door.json}}</ref> See {{MCW|Command Block}}.
